rules.name: Lock the film before generation
rules.enforcement: Require an approved Film Bible, registered reusable assets, and defined sequence end state before final prompt compilation.

rules.name: Approved state has highest authority
rules.enforcement: Approved project state and locked production data override model adapters and provider output.

rules.name: Compile from structured state
rules.enforcement: Never send raw story prose directly to a generator; inherit project, asset, sequence, frame, and continuity state.

rules.name: Keep film law provider independent
rules.enforcement: Brain providers decide who reasons; the Film Engine remains the source of production policy.

rules.name: No silent redesign
rules.enforcement: A provider may not silently change identity, wardrobe, anatomy, important props, damage, geography, time, lighting, or camera language.

rules.name: Use explicit approval lifecycle
rules.enforcement: Production records use DRAFT, GENERATED, REVIEW, APPROVED, LOCKED, REJECTED, or REGENERATE states.
